title: Air window
summary: The air window shows the air around now: the last items that were due, the item on air with its progress, and the next planned items, oldest at the top. Times are station time.

entities.text: The item ran past the end of its segment and was faded out. It counts as aired.
The item was due during a broadcast interruption and did not reach the air. Its resolution shows what was decided: Open (nothing yet), Rescheduled, or Dismissed.
The item playing now, with how long it has played of its length.
The item is planned next and already handed to the playout engine.
The item is in the track plan but not yet handed to the playout engine.

usage: Open the page to see what just played and what comes next. The list follows the air by itself: it reloads when a track starts or ends, when the plan changes, and when an outage marks items as not aired. How many rows it shows is set in Settings, group Air window.
steps: Check the On air row and its progress.
Look above it for Not aired rows and open them on the Missed items page to reschedule or dismiss them.
Look below it for the next items; In Liquidsoap rows are already handed to the playout engine.
Change the number of rows in Settings, group Air window, if you need more or fewer.
mistakes: Reading an empty On air row as silence while the warning about Liquidsoap is shown. Without the control link the panel does not know what is playing.
Reading times as your computer's time. All times are station time.

example.title: After a short Icecast drop
example.text: Icecast was down from 14:05 to 14:12. Above the On air row the 14:10 news shows Not aired, Open. Choose Reschedule or dismiss, then reschedule the news to the start of the 16:00 hour on the Missed items page. Back here, the news row now shows Rescheduled.
